ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with roughly 7-10% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in focal spots and terminal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white pixel blobs are clustered heavily at the extreme distal tips (far left and far right). Discrete white circular spots are scattered bilaterally across the mid-lobe surfaces with higher frequency on the trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Median notch exhibits a V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of ~42 degrees and a significant depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged profile across both lobes; notable deep secondary notch on the right lobe inner margin; approximately 12 distinct peak/valley variations across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the upper margin with a sharp upward inflection at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (3-12 pixels diameter) distributed throughout; heavy colonization of barnacle-like high-contrast structures on the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical to slightly diagonal linear scratches of higher pixel intensity visible on the mid-ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep notches along the trailing edge, particularly the inner right lobe; dense barnacle colonization on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A very large, dense cluster of barnacles on the far right tip, creating a unique protruding texture not present on the smoother parts of the fluke edge.
